subject: PegasusAI - Discovery: coordinating kickoff & technical owners
body:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasusai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PegasusAI discovery - arranging kickoff

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to get an initial discovery on the calendar to align on use cases and tech owners. Attendees from our side will be: myself (product champion), Liam O'Connor (engineering lead), and I'll loop in procurement + security once we pick a slot.

We typically need a 60-minute meeting for discovery (high level + a couple technical questions). A few constraints on our side: Wed (1/24) morning is blocked for team offsite; afternoons are tight.

Can you propose 3 possible windows (we're US EST) and confirm whether you need an NDA or any vendor forms before the meeting? Also, if Redwood prefers bringing an SE for the call, please include them.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Product
PegasusAI

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasusai.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: PegasusAI discovery - arranging kickoff

Hi Samira — great to hear. I can take point on the kickoff. Introducing Dylan (SE) and Karthik (partnering solutions/eng) on CC — they'll help with any deep technical follow-ups and evidence requests.

Proposed windows next week (all in EST):
- Tue 1/23 10:00–11:00
- Thu 1/25 13:00–14:00
- Fri 1/26 10:00–11:00

Agenda (suggested, 60m):
1) 10m - intros & goals
2) 20m - product/PI use case walkthrough (Samira + Marissa)
3) 20m - technical Q&A (Liam + Dylan)
4) 10m - next steps / MAP / procurement ask

I've attached a short mutual action plan stub and a checklist of initial security evidence we commonly get asked for. If you can confirm who will attend from procurement/security, we'll loop them into the calendar invite.

NDA: we typically sign standard mutual NDAs; if you need one in place before the kickoff, send it and we can review.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Attachments: initial-MAP.pdf (application/pdf); security-evidence-request.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

-----
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@pegasusai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasusai.com>
Cc: security@pegasusai.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 11:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: PegasusAI discovery - arranging kickoff

Thanks Samira / Marissa — quick note on our side.

We (engineering) prefer a slot on Fri 1/26 morning but can be flexible if needed. Two technical topics we want to cover in the discovery:
- SSO / SAML / SCIM support and how Redwood integrates with our IdP
- Data residency & log retention (we need the ability to set retention policies and carve out certain logs)

Also: would be great if Redwood can confirm whether you have a non-prod endpoint or sandbox we can test against post-discovery. We'll bring our security contact (security@pegasusai.com) into the thread for any pre-meeting evidence exchange.

FYI — Wed morning is blocked for us as Samira mentioned. Looking at Fri 1/26 10:00–11:00 EST as the best option.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Engineering Lead | PegasusAI
liam.oconnor@pegasusai.com

-----
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@pegasusai.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 09:30:22 -0800
Subject: Re: PegasusAI discovery - arranging kickoff

Hi all — Dylan on the SE side. Quick notes so we can have a productive discovery: 

- We can cover SSO and SCIM at a high level in the discovery; we typically follow up with a 30m technical deep-dive if you want config examples.
- For data residency / retention: Redwood supports region pinning for deployments and configurable audit/log retention; I can bring sample retention policies.
- Sandbox: we can provision a short-lived non-prod endpoint for engineering validation (I'll kick off an internal request once we confirm the date).

Suggested meeting format: 45m discovery (as Marissa outlined) + optional 60m technical deep-dive the same or following week. If security@pegasusai.com wants a pre-call to exchange evidence, we can do a 30m sync.

I'm attaching a high-level architecture diagram and a quick SSO compatibility matrix for reference. If you have sample prompts / data shape you plan to send, please paste a short example so I can tailor the demo.

Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-arch-highlevel.png (image/png); sso-compatibility-matrix.csv (text/csv)

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@pegasusai.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@pegasusai.com>, procurement@pegasusai.com, security@pegasusai.com
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jan 2028 15:04:10 -0800
Subject: Re: PegasusAI discovery - arranging kickoff

Thanks everyone — looks like Friday works best. I booked Fri 1/26 13:00–14:00 EST (10:00–11:00 PST) and sent a calendar invite (Calendly link / invite attached).

Practicals / next steps: 
- Dylan will lead the technical Q&A.
- Samira / Liam: please confirm final attendee list and paste one sample prompt or data shape you want us to walk through.
- security@pegasusai.com: if you want to do a pre-call to exchange the evidence list, Dylan is available Tue 1/23 11:00–11:30 EST.
- procurement@pegasusai.com: I've attached a mutual action plan (MAP_v1.pdf) and a one-page SLA summary. If you have a standard PO template or commercial redlines, please send prior to the meeting so we can prep.

Attachments included: MAP_v1.pdf; SLA_Summary.pdf
Calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-discovery
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-2874

Looking forward — see you on Friday,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf); SLA_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)
